dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Paraneoplastic opsoclonus-myoclonus-ataxia syndrome, likely associated with an occult malignancy (most commonly small cell lung carcinoma, breast carcinoma, or ovarian carcinoma; typically anti-Ri/ANNA-2 antibody mediated), suggested by the chronic medical history

Alternatives:
1. Idiopathic (post-infectious autoimmune) opsoclonus-myoclonus-ataxia syndrome
2. Autoimmune or viral brainstem/cerebellar encephalitis
3. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration with secondary opsoclonus (anti-Hu or anti-Yo associated)
